seed.name: Bland Landscaping Company
seed.description: Bland Landscaping is a regional, private equity backed, Commercial and Estate Landscape Management and Contracting business headquartered in Apex, NC. Since our humble beginnings in 1976, our geographic footprint has grown to span across from The Carolinas into Northern Florida. While we are best known for our landscaping and grounds management work in the Horticultural arena, we also perform Landscape Construction and Stormwater Management services.Our team of seasoned industry leaders have been recognized with numerous awards and featured in countless news articles over the years that have highlighted our commitment to both the industry and the communities to which we belong. We believe that responsible business and corporate involvement builds stronger communities and we exercise that belief on a very regular basis as part of our business philosophy. Likewise, we believe stronger communities build stronger businesses, and in that regard we are fortunate to be located in a thriving region of the country that has afforded us the opportunity to build a solid business that offers excellent service to our customers, while creating endless opportunities for landscape professionals.

peers.name: Yellowstone Landscape
peers.description: Yellowstone Landscape began in 2008 with the unification of established, independently successful local and regional landscape companies. Since then, we’ve been linked by a common goal to better serve our clients, sharing decades of experience in landscape maintenance, landscape design and installation, landscape enhancements, irrigation systems, tree care, snow and ice management services, interiorscapes, and sports field maintenance. Yellowstone has become one of the industry’s fastest-growing and most trusted commercial landscaping firms, proudly serving more than 6000 client properties from local branch operations facilities across the United States. We offer a uniquely comprehensive selection of services, allowing us to serve a project through the years - from planning and design to a mature and thriving landscape in the ground.Our 6500 Landscape Professionals are dedicated to creating and maintaining green spaces that enhance the quality of life where you live, work, and play. We provide professional landscaping services to some of the most outstanding homeowner associations, local and state agencies and municipalities, master-planned developments, hotels and resorts, corporate campuses, commercial office parks, schools, hospitals, apartment communities, and retail centers across the country. peers.name: Cumberland Landscape Group
peers.description: Cumberland Landscape Group is a regional commercial landscape company with its headquarters in Atlanta, Georgia, and with hopes of further expanding across the Southeast in the coming years.  The company's roots date back to performing as the in-house landscape group for Equity Residential, but we have been fortunate to grow outside of Equity over the years to now include all asset classes. We are a group of dedicated professionals with decades of landscape experience, and our competitive advantage is our deep desire to listen to the needs of our clients and to deliver creative solutions to achieve their goals. Our Culture is based around treating people the way we ourselves want to be treated. We do this by doing what is "right" versus what might always be the most profitable, and when we make mistakes, which are inevitable, we apologize and work to make sure things are corrected. No one is flawless, so we make sure to own that fact and make sure things are correct in the end.  We want to be the best landscaping company in the market.We are one of the largest, locally owned landscaping companies, and we pride ourselves on our three core values of the Cumberland Culture: 1.Transparency: We engage in open, honest and appropriate sharing of information and feedback in all aspects of our business. 2.Respect: We live the golden rule through our commitment to always treat people the way we would want to be treated.3.Teamwork: We are collectively committed to the success of the company and one another, and are fully accountable for ‘my part of the whole’.

peers.description: Commercial Landscape Management is a homegrown local company with over four decades of experience in the Triangle. We have extensive knowledge and partnerships to serve your commercial needs in the Raleigh, Cary and Durham, NC area.We here to handle all of your commercial property landscaping needs. We not only enhance your front doors, drive entrances, and signs, but we maintain your new landscape to make sure it keeps its appeal for years to come. Nothing is worse than adding shrubs that overgrow their space too soon or get attacked by pesky insects and disease due to lack of pruning and care. A brand new installation can look worn and tired much too soon if your maintenance team isn’t proactive enough to keep the plants looking tight and healthy. Shrubs can grow out of control and block line of sight areas, encroach on sidewalks and entryways and cover signs that advertise for your business or tenants. With the team at Commercial Landscape Management on your side, you can rest easy knowing your investment will be protected for years to come.
